newsitem.title: USA: Sears completes Orchard Supply acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Sears completes Orchard Supply acquisition.

text.p: Sears, Roebuck & Co said Thursday it completed the previously announced acquisition of all outstanding shares of Orchard Supply Hardware Stores Corp common.

A Sears subsidiary on September 19 accepted about 8.7 million shares, representing 98.67 percent of Orchard's outstanding stock, at $35 per share. The Sears subsidiary was merged into Orchard on September 25.
Orchard Supply, through its 61 hardware superstores in California, serves homeowners engaged in repair and maintenance projects.
Sears owns and operates 2,300 department and specialty stores in the United States, including HomeLife furniture, Sears Hardware and automotive parts and tire outlets.
